title: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts make two one-line replacements so reach verdicts for compose runs address the exe
description:
In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts make two one-line replacements so reach verdicts for compose runs address the execution row that actually exists, instead of a synthesized id that matches no row. Both target lines were verified verbatim-unique against the current file. The compose response body now carries the real id: as of development-vessel be8ff83 the featureComposeReport body includes a field execution_id holding the exec_* row id the trace store returned (null when emission failed), observed live at 09:15:37 with execution_id=exec_1788686137787_aypktaaorip matching an existing feature_compose row.

Replacement 1 — the early edit-intent result. The line

                executionId: earlyLandedSha ? `feature_compose:${earlyLandedSha}` : undefined,

becomes

                executionId: (typeof earlyBody.execution_id === "string" && earlyBody.execution_id.startsWith("exec_")) ? earlyBody.execution_id : (earlyLandedSha ? `feature_compose:${earlyLandedSha}` : undefined),

earlyBody is already in scope (declared ~50 lines above as `const earlyBody = resolveReportBody(earlyJ);`).

Replacement 2 — the persisted satisfier trace id. The line

                  id: landedSha ? `feature_compose:${landedSha}` : `feature_compose:staged-${editSite}`,

becomes

                  id: (typeof body.execution_id === "string" && body.execution_id.startsWith("exec_")) ? body.execution_id : (landedSha ? `feature_compose:${landedSha}` : `feature_compose:staged-${editSite}`),

body is already in scope (the same object read as body.semantic_gate a few lines above).

Both replacements preserve the existing expression verbatim as the fallback, so behaviour is unchanged whenever the report carries no id — the synthetic form remains for null/absent, keeping an absent id distinguishable from a fabricated one. The startsWith("exec_") guard means only a store-issued row id is ever preferred.

Why: the synthetic feature_compose:<sha> matches no row in the trace store, so the SYNTHETIC_EXECUTION_ID_PREFIXES handling skips verdict writes on the premise that no execution row was persisted — a premise that became false when the compose resolver began returning the real id. Consequence today: 868 exec_* compose rows carry their outcomes ungraded and self-development has 6 graded rows in three weeks, every one keyed to a landed commit; refusals and near-misses — the majority of the lane's behaviour — are structurally invisible to the learner. Verification, one query after the next compose completes: SELECT count() FROM execution WHERE activity_id = 'feature_compose' AND reached != NONE AND id CONTAINS 'exec_' must become greater than zero, which it has never been.
